claims: On March 18, 2026, Japan defeated South Korea 4-1 in the AFC Women's Asian Cup semi-final.
The AFC Women's Asian Cup semi-final was at Stadium Australia.
Japan's goals were scored by Riko Ueki, Maika Hamano, Saki Kumagai, and Remina Chiba.
Kang Chae-Rim scored a late consolation goal for South Korea.
Japan has scored 28 goals in 5 games.
Japan has conceded only one goal in 5 games.
Japan advances to the final against Australia.
South Korea is generally 15-20% cheaper than Japan for meals, transport, and accommodation.
Japan has an extensive bullet train system (Shinkansen).
As of late 2025, some data suggests South Korea has surpassed Japan in GDP per capita.
